- [USER] User inquired about TruWest Credit Union.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] TruWest Credit Union is a not-for-profit financial cooperative established in 1952 to serve employees of Motorola in Phoenix, Arizona.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] TruWest Credit Union is based in Tempe, Arizona, and serves members across the United States.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] TruWest Credit Union offers checking and savings accounts, loans, credit cards, and investment services.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Members can access online banking and mobile banking services to manage their accounts.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] TruWest Credit Union is committed to providing personalized service to its members with dedicated account managers.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] TruWest Credit Union supports local charities and organizations through its Community Connection program and offers financial education programs.
